coverage.interpretation: Depth counts timestamp uncertainty intervals compatible with each instant; it does not count confirmed simultaneous events or measure service load. Zero depth means no dated interval covers that span in this evidence model, not proof of inactivity. Undated lines cannot be placed. Clock bounds are analyst assertions. Replay checks consistency, not authenticity or completeness. Source bytes and messages are omitted from this report.

interpretation: Depth is timestamp-uncertainty interval coverage, not confirmed concurrency or service load.
Zero depth is not downtime; widening asserted clock bounds can change every total.
Budgets are supplied policy, not statistical or availability guarantees.
Replay checks internal consistency, not log truth, completeness or clock accuracy.
Receipt embeds unredacted source logs; hashes do not establish authorship or creation time.
Retain the content digest independently to identify a receipt; whitespace is not pinned.

clock_model.assumption: Each source clock differs from UTC by at most this bound at every event.
clock_model.precision_assumption: Timestamps are truncated to their displayed precision.

limitations: Actual local process observation timestamps, not an external service incident. Tool demo payloads are synthetic. Clock accuracy is unmeasured; 750 ms is illustrative. Budgets allow the whole window uncovered and at most eight compatible intervals on average; they are post hoc examples, not SLOs. Coverage and mean depth do not measure runtime, downtime, confirmed concurrency or service load.
